column1: # Chrome, through `just conformance`. Where a flex container puts what overflows it.
# Measured on Chrome Headless Shell 159.0.8154.6, the chromium Playwright pins here.
# A 40x40 flex container at 60,60 on the page.
# `lines`: two children 40 along the main axis and 30 across it, a line each
# under `flex-wrap`, so the lines need 60 of the 40 there is, for every `align-content`.
# `items`: one child 47 along the main axis and 20 across, for every `justify-content`.
# `wrapped`: under `flex-wrap: wrap`, children 47, 15, 15 along the main axis and 10 across,
# so the first is alone on an overflowing line and the next two share one that fits.
# Every case in both writing directions, `dir`. Every child has `flex-shrink: 0`.
# Rectangles are the children relative to the container, from `getBoundingClientRect`.
